sourceSentences: [0] I think in this matchup, uh, Jay has to hit shock blasts because if I'm best I can short trade you with W
[0] If I W his damage and hammer stands, he quite literally gets like no damage through on me
[0] Hitting shock loss is really important, forcing her W cuz if she she manages to trade you when you show W up and hammer stance, she eats your whole hammer stance combo
[0] Can't really open him while he has hammer E and stuff. though
[1] some advice when playing up against her her W cool Down's extremely long so good to look that up before you play and try to play around that punish when and have big shields on cool down
[1] a lot of people just mindlessly get hit by the q1 and Q2 where Q2 is more easier to dodge than q1 but q1 range is quite short so if you bait her out if you pretend to run at her
[1] one more piece of advice as well is making sure you're punishing his hammer e cool down it's extremely long a lot of Champions Gap closes it's going to be shorter than it
[1] if he knocks you away then you've got a great opportunity to use q and E together that's how you're going to win the trade up against him
[2] now playing around her Q2 is also important at the start when nobody knew what she did very easy to hit it
[2] but now when you verse good players they know when you're going to be using Q2 they're pre- dodging it
[3] try not to use melee e when engaging but use it when she tries to engage you
